notes: Every table of the OpenSource catalog as registered on the qualification cluster (2026-09-14, westus2). Locations are relative to the container root path; row counts are the exact COUNT(*) the registration verifies. The Engine catalog lives on the coordinator volume and is not part of the PostgreSQL snapshot, so a cluster restore re-registers from this file: copy the snapshot prefix to the new account, then run scripts/register-curated-catalog.py from an API pod with KAVEON_LAKE_ADLS_ACCOUNT set.
